steps.text: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
What did you do?
Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
How was the walk?
Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
I'm glad ❤️
I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
What's on your mind?
Would you come over and stay the night with me?
Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
Yes ❤️
YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
I'd really like that
I thought about asking yesterday
You should have. I would've been tempted
Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
When can you come?
My afternoon is free after university
I can go home, get my things and come over around five
Five sounds good
And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
That's what I'm looking forward to
Me too
Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
A FEW MINUTES LATER
Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
Very organised
I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
Of course. You've looked good in mine before
Then I'll let you choose one for me
Consider it ready
I hope you know I might get attached to it
I'll take the risk
There. Almost packed
You look very pleased about that
I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
Along with its owner
Especially its owner ❤️
Actually, before I finish packing...
What are you up to?
Giving you a little preview 🤍
A FEW MINUTES LATER
What do you think?
You look gorgeous
And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
I wanted to distract you a little 😌
It worked. Now I wish you were here
What would you do if I was?
Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
Wait. One more before I change
A MINUTE LATER
There. Your last preview for tonight
You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
I intend to 🤍
Keep those pictures just for yourself
Of course. They're staying between us
Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
You will have my full attention
That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
I wasn't planning that
Then we'll be fine 😌
Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
That wasn't in the invitation
It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
I'll survive
Good. I want you there when I wake up too
You will have me there
That's the part I keep thinking about
Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
I liked having you beside me yesterday
Tomorrow we can stay like that
You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
Only until tomorrow afternoon
I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
Both will arrive together this time 😌
Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
Me too. Goodnight ❤️
